review.method: Rendered all twelve unmodified sample inputs with renderPortrait at 2048x2560 using the real catalog and existing deterministic finish. Saved PNGs and sidecars in test/scratch/catalog-review/. Visually inspected each face crop, master region x=360,y=620,width=1000,height=820 displayed at 500x410. No image-to-image harmonisation. Scratch files are not submitted.
review.summary: All ten expressions are visually distinguishable by lid and mouth shape; all twelve show readable iris/pupil paint. Underlays take the selected skin colour, but local colour/texture matches are imperfect. This is not visual approval: three expressions have severely detached mouths, and additional integration repairs are listed by path.

samples.seen: Asymmetric low lids and lifted lip corner distinguish smug. Amber irises remain readable through spectacles. Lids are green; the red lips float well below and left of the intact neutral mouth, outside the face silhouette.

Tense narrow lids, lateral pupils and a compressed mouth read as wary. Lids take the pale lichen colour. Both irises are visible, although the far eye projects left and the broad side-eye iris paint looks comparatively flat. Mouth is seated on the muzzle.

Relaxed rounded lids and open irises read calmer than smug. Lids are blue-grey. Red lips float under the original neutral seam, with the chain crossing the detached lips. Rare cap has an irregular transparent-looking gap at the forehead.

Down-slanting heavy lids and exaggerated downturned mouth clearly read as a scowl. Irises remain visible in shadow and lids are brown-olive. A large smooth muzzle patch has abrupt side edges and a sheen/texture mismatch against the rougher skin.

Uneven sleepy lids and a wide open toothy grin read as dopey. Both irises are visible and lids are cream-toned. Mouth placement is substantially better than expr-a; teeth are pointed rather than the requested blunt teeth. Seer hood is still a visibly geometric green arc in this checkout.

Resolute alias selects regal. Level lowered lids and a firm closed mouth read composed. Irises remain visible and lids are green; lips follow the muzzle, although brow patches are smoother than the base.

Dubious alias selects weeping. Raised pinched brows, an open downturned mouth and two tears distinguish grief; near tear is bright, far tear dark. Irises are readable through spectacles and lids take the brown-olive tone.

High brows, wide eyes and a dark rounded O mouth clearly read as surprise. Lids are reddish-brown and both irises remain readable through the monocle. Thin green edging survives around the O mouth on red skin. Rare cap has the same forehead gap as sample 03.

Wistful alias selects melancholy. Lifted inner brows, narrowed sad eyes and a pronounced downturned mouth differ from scowl. Lids recolour pale grey-green and irises remain visible. Lips are detached below the original neutral mouth and extend off the muzzle.

Amused alias selects sly. An asymmetric squint and long upturned closed smile are distinct from regal and dim-grin. Both pupils remain visible, far eye narrowly so. Lids recolour cream, but green edging remains along the upper mouth on ivory.

Same calm blue-grey lids and readable hazel irises as 03. Detached red lips and intact neutral mouth persist, with the necklace crossing the lips. Geometric seer hood and rare-cap forehead gap also remain visible.
The asymmetric lids take a reddish-brown tone, and olive irises are clear. The smirk remains detached below the original mouth, as in 01; the expression mouth does not fit the skin.
